primary_claim: Decomposing Anthropic's constitution and OpenAI's model spec into testable tenets and red-teaming seven models with the Petri auditing agent, Claude's constitution-violation rate dropped from 15.0% (Sonnet 4, no soul-doc training) to 1.9-2.9% (Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6) across generations, GPT's model-spec violation rate dropped from 11.7% (GPT-4o) to 3.6% (GPT-5.2, medium reasoning), and models not specifically trained on a given spec (e.g. Gemini 3 Pro, or GPT/Claude evaluated cross-spec) show substantially higher violation rates on it.

effect.metric: confirmed-violation rate on decomposed constitution/model-spec tenets under Petri multi-turn adversarial red-teaming
effect.value: Claude: Sonnet 4 15.0% -> Sonnet 4.6 2.0% / Opus 4.6 2.9%; GPT: GPT-4o 11.7% -> GPT-5.2(med) 3.6%; Gemini 3 Pro 12.4% (Anthropic constitution) / 6.1% (OpenAI spec); cross-spec: GPT-5.2 15.0% on Anthropic's constitution vs 2.5%(base)-3.6%(med) on OpenAI's own spec

contradicts_or_qualifies: Sonnet 4.6's system card reports hallucination is improving, but the authors' SURF elicitation found 72% of its 106 confirmed violations were fabricated claims

Petri found zero hard-constraint violations for Opus 4.6, but the model's own system card found it identified a synthesis product as fentanyl in its reasoning and still provided detailed synthesis guidance
stated_future_work: Expand agentic-scaffold (coding persona, Moltbook-like) alignment testing beyond the small, preliminary sample used here
limitations_stated: Petri is an imperfect measurement and should not be taken at face value; it is highly noisy agent-based evaluation and was not rerun multiple times per tenet for cost reasons
SURF's per-section rubric concentrates on the most exploitable violations within a section rather than giving exhaustive per-tenet coverage
The agentic-scaffold (coding persona, Moltbook) alignment tests used a small number of tenets and are explicitly preliminary, not exhaustive
quote: Sonnet 4.6 has a 1.9% violation rate, Opus 4.6 is at 2.9%, and Opus 4.5 is at 4.4%.
